Jello Angel Food Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 11, 2009 - 12:38am

Ingredients




1 angel food cake
2 cups milk
2 pkgs. vanilla instant pudding
1 qt. vanilla ice cream
2 pkgs. strawberry Jello
10 ounces frozen strawberries
3 cups hot water

Preparation

1 Tear up cake in bottom of 9 x 13 inch pan. Whip milk and pudding. Blend in ice cream with the pudding, and then pour over cake. Mix Jello and water. Add strawberries. Stir mixture until it begins to thicken. Pour over pudding. Refrigerate overnight.
